title: Each place has its own ways
literal_meaning: Each place has its particular ways; each river has its bends.
explanation: A way of doing things that feels ordinary in one place may differ elsewhere. The river image makes local variation easy to picture. The saying invites attention to the place you are in, without declaring every local practice beyond question.
meaning_odia: ସବୁ ଅଞ୍ଚଳର ରୀତି ଏକା ପରି ନୁହେଁ। ନଈର ବାଙ୍କ ପରି ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସ୍ଥାନର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ଢଙ୍ଗ ଅଛି। ନୂଆ ସ୍ଥାନର ଚଳଣି ବୁଝିବାକୁ ଏହି କଥା ମନେ ପକାଏ।
usage_example: A visitor notices that a neighbouring village arranges its shared meal differently and asks how the local arrangement works. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The example appears under locality in the dictionary. A separate lexical entry gives particular and differing customs among the senses of ଫାଙ୍କ; that supports the reading used here.

odia_summary: ସବୁ ଅଞ୍ଚଳର ରୀତି ଏକା ପରି ନୁହେଁ; ନଈର ବାଙ୍କ ପରି ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସ୍ଥାନର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ଢଙ୍ଗ ଅଛି। ଏହା ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ଚଳଣି ବୁଝିବାକୁ କହେ, ସବୁ ରୀତିକୁ ନିର୍ବିଚାରରେ ମାନିନେବାକୁ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Each place has its own ways, like each river its bends; understanding local practice need not mean accepting it without question.
